constraints: The purple_box is occupied by the blue_book and must be cleared before placing other objects on it.
The cyan_tray and orange_tray are unoccupied and available for placement.
The yellow_block must be moved only after confirming it is not already on a designated zone.
The robot must verify that the target zones are clear before placing objects.
task_spec.refined_instruction: The robot should first move the blue_book from the purple_box to the cyan_tray, as it is the only object explicitly mentioned in the request and is currently on a non-tray zone. Then, the yellow_block, which is not on any zone, should be moved to the orange_tray, as it is an unoccupied tray and a suitable location for a block. The robot must ensure that each target zone is clear before placing an object. Success is achieved when both the blue_book and yellow_block are placed on their respective target zones (cyan_tray and orange_tray), and no objects remain on the purple_box or in undefined zones.
